entries.meaningZh: 放线菌丝体的；规范形式actinomycelial

entries.zh: 论文附录包含一幅放线菌丝体图。

entries.en: The chemical register records aetiohemin under its historical spelling.
entries.zh: 化学登记册按照历史拼写记录了初氯血红素。

entries.en: An aetite with a hollow centre is displayed in the case.
entries.zh: 展柜里陈列着一块中心空心的鹰石。

entries.en: The carving has an aetomorphic head and human arms.
entries.zh: 这件雕刻有鹰形的头和人的手臂。

entries.meaningZh: AEX；所给历史混合物名称缩写
entries.en: The archive explains AEX in a note beside the original label.
entries.zh: 档案在原标签旁的注释中解释了AEX。

entries.en: The cabinetmaker chose afara for the broad panels.
entries.zh: 木工选择非洲榄仁木制作宽板。

entries.meaningZh: AFBA；武装部队广播工作者协会
entries.en: The old programme lists AFBA among the participating associations.
entries.zh: 旧节目单把AFBA列在参与协会中。

entries.zh: 系统图包含一个自动文件与文档编制模块。

entries.en: The maintenance report includes the AFDET output.
entries.zh: 维护报告包含故障自动检测的输出。

entries.en: The circuit board places the AFE close to the sensor connector.
entries.zh: 电路板把模拟前端置于传感器接头附近。

entries.en: The equipment list includes an AFFA for the sound measurements.
entries.zh: 设备清单包括一台用于声音测量的音频傅里叶分析器。

entries.en: The actor drew on affect-memory while preparing the role.
entries.zh: 演员在准备角色时运用了情感记忆。

entries.en: The neighbours affectionally called him the street's unofficial mayor.
entries.zh: 邻居们亲切地称他为这条街的非正式市长。

entries.meaningZh: 情感性癫痫（德语历史名称）
entries.en: The historian translated affektepilepsie in the old case report.
entries.zh: 历史学者翻译了旧病例报告中的情感性癫痫这一德语名称。

entries.en: The medieval description tells of a blade kept well affiled.
entries.zh: 这段中世纪描述讲到了一把磨得很锋利的刀刃。

entries.meaningZh: 糖的洗炼；糖液精炼前的预净化
entries.en: The factory diagram places affination before the next refining stage.
entries.zh: 工厂流程图把糖的洗炼放在下一精炼阶段之前。

entries.meaningZh: 仿射张量；所给数学术语
entries.en: The lecture notes represent the affinor by a matrix.
entries.zh: 讲义用矩阵表示仿射张量。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the claim could be made affirmably.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问这一主张是否能够肯定地提出。

entries.meaningZh: 近月飞行（所给航天术语）
entries.en: The mission sketch labels the near-lunar segment afflight.
entries.zh: 任务草图把近月阶段标为近月飞行。

entries.meaningZh: 可负担住房；常规形式affordable housing
entries.en: The council reserved the site for affordable housing.
entries.zh: 市政委员会将这块地预留给可负担住房。

entries.en: The affrayed messenger could scarcely speak.
entries.zh: 受惊的信使几乎说不出话来。

entries.en: She looked affrightedly towards the dark staircase.
entries.zh: 她惊恐地望向昏暗的楼梯。

entries.en: The court index uses afft. for the sworn statement.
entries.zh: 法院索引用afft.代表宣誓书。

entries.en: An Afghanistani in the group translated the local newspaper report.
entries.zh: 组里一位阿富汗人翻译了那篇当地报纸报道。

entries.en: The diagnostic panel displays the AFI result.
entries.zh: 诊断面板显示了自动故障隔离结果。

entries.meaningZh: AFIP；美国武装部队病理研究所（历史机构名称）
entries.en: The archived report carries an AFIP reference number.
entries.zh: 存档报告带有美国武装部队病理研究所的参考编号。

entries.meaningZh: 嘶嘶作响的；起泡活跃的
entries.en: The kitchen was afizz with activity before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来前，厨房里忙得热火朝天。

entries.en: The financial article includes a paragraph about Aflac.
entries.zh: 这篇财经文章有一段介绍Aflac。

entries.en: The archived catalogue includes a package marked Aflix.
entries.zh: 存档目录包含一个标有安果的包装。

entries.en: The image caption identifies the instrument as an AFM.
entries.zh: 图注明确说明仪器为原子力显微镜。

entries.en: The software manual devotes a chapter to AFO.
entries.zh: 软件手册用一章介绍高级文件编制。

entries.meaningZh: 更有理由地；何况；规范形式a fortiori
entries.en: If the rule applies to minor errors, it applies a fortiori to deliberate fraud.
entries.zh: 如果这条规则适用于小错误，那就更有理由适用于蓄意欺诈。

entries.meaningZh: AFOSR；美国空军科学研究办公室
entries.en: The acknowledgement lists AFOSR among the funding organizations.
entries.zh: 致谢把美国空军科学研究办公室列在资助机构中。

entries.en: The article explains what the AFQT score represents.
entries.zh: 文章解释了武装部队资格测验分数代表什么。

entries.meaningZh: AFRI；急性发热性呼吸道疾病
entries.en: The glossary expands AFRI at its first appearance.
entries.zh: 术语表在AFRI首次出现时写出了急性发热性呼吸道疾病的全称。

entries.en: The essay explores Africanity through language and music.
entries.zh: 文章通过语言与音乐探讨非洲文化特性。

entries.meaningZh: 阿夫里迪蜡防印花布（所选纺织义）
entries.en: The textile display includes a length of afridi.
entries.zh: 纺织展中有一段阿夫里迪蜡防印花布。

entries.en: The cabinet door has an afrormosia veneer.
entries.zh: 柜门贴有非洲红豆木饰面。

entries.en: AFRS generated the year-end summary.
entries.zh: 高级财务报表系统生成了年终汇总。

entries.meaningZh: AFSCME；美国州县与市政雇员联合会
entries.en: The meeting notice was circulated by AFSCME.
entries.zh: 会议通知由美国州县与市政雇员联合会发出。

entries.en: The crew gathered on the aft-deck.
entries.zh: 船员们聚集在后甲板上。

entries.meaningZh: AFTE；所给美国技术工程师联盟缩写
entries.en: The archived newsletter names AFTE as its publisher.
entries.zh: 存档通讯注明AFTE为出版方。

entries.en: The production chart includes an after-bake stage.
entries.zh: 生产流程图包括一个后烘阶段。

entries.en: The metallurgical report records the duration of the after-blow.
entries.zh: 冶金报告记录了后吹的持续时间。

entries.en: The glossary includes after-cataract under historical ophthalmic terminology.
entries.zh: 术语表在历史眼科学术语中收录了后发性白内障。

entries.en: The author separated after-condensation from the initial change.
entries.zh: 作者把后凝作用与最初的变化区分开。

entries.en: The analysis table lists the after-cut separately.
entries.zh: 分析表单独列出了后馏分。

entries.en: A coil of rope lay on the after-deck.
entries.zh: 艉甲板上放着一卷绳索。

entries.meaningZh: 喷油后滴漏（所选机械义）
entries.en: The inspection report notes after-dripping at the nozzle.
entries.zh: 检查报告记录了喷嘴处的喷油后滴漏。

entries.en: The diagram labels the last step after-filtration.
entries.zh: 图中把最后一步标为后过滤。

entries.en: The after-frame supports the back of the assembly.
entries.zh: 后架支撑着组件的后部。

entries.en: The materials report compares hardness before and after after-hardening.
entries.zh: 材料报告比较了后硬化前后的硬度。

entries.en: The engine report identifies after-ignition as the issue under discussion.
entries.zh: 发动机报告把后期点火列为讨论的问题。

entries.en: We arranged an after-lunch walk through the gardens.
entries.zh: 我们安排了一次午饭后穿过花园的散步。

entries.en: The after-midnight train was almost empty.
entries.zh: 午夜后的那班火车几乎空无一人。

entries.meaningZh: 后短语（所给计算机语法术语）
entries.en: The syntax diagram marks the optional after-phrase.
entries.zh: 语法图标出了可选的后短语。

entries.en: The machine log records an after-punching error.
entries.zh: 机器日志记录了一次重复穿孔错误。

entries.en: The contract includes a year of after-service.
entries.zh: 合同包含一年的售后服务。

entries.en: The layout settings add an after-space below each heading.
entries.zh: 版式设置在每个标题下方添加一处后空白。

entries.en: She packed after-sun with the other holiday toiletries.
entries.zh: 她把晒后护理用品与其他度假洗护用品一起装好。

entries.meaningZh: 后粘性；后期发粘（所选材料义）
entries.en: The coating report notes slight after-tack on the surface.
entries.zh: 涂层报告记录了表面轻微的后期发粘。

entries.en: We had coffee afterward.
entries.zh: 后来我们喝了咖啡。

entries.en: The graph shows after-working after the load is removed.
entries.zh: 图中显示了卸载后的弹性后效。

entries.meaningZh: 后续破坏；地面沉陷后的进一步破裂
entries.en: The survey documented afterbreak around the original subsidence.
entries.zh: 调查记录了原沉陷周围的后续破坏。

entries.en: The hull drawing labels the afterchine.
entries.zh: 船体图标出了后舷嵴。

entries.en: The diagram places aftercooling downstream of the compressor.
entries.zh: 图中把后冷却放在压缩机下游。

entries.en: The poem imagines an afterdeath free from earthly worries.
entries.zh: 这首诗想象了一个没有尘世烦恼的来世。

entries.en: The test report records the observed afterflaming.
entries.zh: 测试报告记录了观察到的续燃现象。

entries.en: The cargo list assigns the crates to the afterhold.
entries.zh: 货物清单把这些木箱分配到船后货舱。

entries.meaningZh: 不自主后运动；康斯塔姆现象
entries.en: The lecture describes aftermovement as an observation in motor physiology.
entries.zh: 讲座把不自主后运动作为运动生理学中的一种观察现象加以描述。

entries.en: The report distinguishes the main product from the afterproduct.
entries.zh: 报告区分了主要产品与后产物。

entries.en: The tea left a pleasantly smoky aftertaste.
entries.zh: 这种茶留下了令人愉快的烟熏余味。

entries.en: The small boat rocked in the aftertossing of the departing ship.
entries.zh: 小船在离去大船留下的船尾余波中摇晃。

entries.meaningZh: 粘土平原（所给地理名称）
entries.en: The map marks an aftont beyond the low ridge.
entries.zh: 地图在低山脊那边标出了一片粘土平原。

entries.en: Her text asked whether we were free that afty.
entries.zh: 她发消息问我们那天下午是否有空。

entries.en: The comparison table gives the AFUE for each furnace.
entries.zh: 对比表列出了每台暖炉的年度燃料利用效率。

entries.meaningZh: 农业的（非正式缩略用法）
entries.en: He takes ag classes at the local college.
entries.zh: 他在当地学院学习农业课程。

entries.meaningZh: AGAI；英国陆军常务与行政指令
entries.en: The archived memo refers readers to the relevant AGAI section.
entries.zh: 存档备忘录提示读者查阅相关的陆军常务与行政指令章节。

entries.en: Please read the last paragraph again.
entries.zh: 请再读一遍最后一段。

entries.en: The proposal had more againsters than supporters.
entries.zh: 这项提议的反对者比支持者更多。

entries.meaningZh: AGAK；所给乙酰甘氨酰胺与水合氯醛制剂缩写
entries.en: The historical catalogue expands AGAK beside the original product entry.
entries.zh: 历史目录在原产品条目旁写出了AGAK的全称。

entries.en: The medical glossary lists agalaxy among older lactation terms.
entries.zh: 医学术语表把泌乳缺乏列在旧泌乳术语中。

entries.en: The old botanical system places these plants among the agamae.
entries.zh: 旧植物分类体系把这些植物归入隐花植物。

entries.meaningZh: 喇叭鸟；南美洲一种长腿鸟
entries.en: An agami crossed the path ahead of the observers.
entries.zh: 一只喇叭鸟从观察者前方的小路穿过。

entries.meaningZh: 无性生殖；裂殖生殖期（旧术语）
entries.en: The life-cycle chart labels the agamocytogeny stage.
entries.zh: 生活史图标出了无性生殖阶段。

entries.meaningZh: 灵感的源泉（文学典故用法）
entries.en: For the poet, the quiet garden became an aganippe.
entries.zh: 对诗人而言，安静的花园成了灵感的源泉。

entries.en: The dessert used agar-agar to hold its shape.
entries.zh: 这道甜点使用琼脂来保持形状。

entries.meaningZh: AGARD；航空研究与发展顾问组
entries.en: The bibliography includes an AGARD publication.
entries.zh: 参考书目包括一份航空研究与发展顾问组的出版物。

entries.en: The library’s agaricology shelf contains several illustrated monographs.
entries.zh: 图书馆伞菌学书架上有几部配插图的专著。

entries.en: The archive photograph shows a bottle marked Agarol.
entries.zh: 档案照片展示了一个标有阿加罗耳的瓶子。

entries.en: The atlas lists agastria among congenital anatomical conditions.
entries.zh: 图谱把无胃畸形列在先天解剖异常中。

entries.meaningZh: 神灵附体妄想（旧医学名称）
entries.en: The historian explains agathodemania as an obsolete diagnostic term.
entries.zh: 历史学者把神灵附体妄想解释为一个过时诊断术语。

entries.en: The stellar-evolution diagram marks the AGB in red.
entries.zh: 恒星演化图用红色标出了渐近巨星分支。

entries.en: The aviation manual defines AGCA in its navigation glossary.
entries.zh: 航空手册在导航术语表中定义了自动地面控制进场。

entries.meaningZh: 年龄调整的；年龄标化的
entries.en: The report compares age-adjusted rates across the regions.
entries.zh: 报告比较了各地区年龄标化后的比率。

entries.meaningZh: 年龄限制；常规形式age limit
entries.en: The competition has an upper age limit.
entries.zh: 这项比赛设有年龄上限。

entries.en: The census includes an age-sex distribution chart.
entries.zh: 人口普查包含一张年龄性别分布图。

entries.en: The memoir describes a close friendship between two agelikes.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了两个同龄人之间的亲密友谊。

entries.en: Several agencies coordinated the housing project.
entries.zh: 几个机构共同协调了住房项目。

entries.meaningZh: 无颏头畸胎（旧分类名称）
entries.en: The historical specimen index uses ageniocephalus.
entries.zh: 历史标本索引使用了无颏头畸胎这一名称。

entries.meaningZh: 无生殖器畸形；生殖器发育不全（旧术语）
entries.en: The medical atlas includes agenosomia in its developmental section.
entries.zh: 医学图谱在发育部分收录了生殖器发育不全。

entries.en: The article compares the agentivity of the two subjects.
entries.zh: 文章比较了两个主语的施事性。

entries.meaningZh: 爱克发；摄影器材与材料品牌
entries.en: She found an old Agfa camera in the cupboard.
entries.zh: 她在柜子里找到了一台旧爱克发相机。

entries.meaningZh: 暴力滋事；规范俚语形式aggro
entries.en: We left before the argument turned into aggro.
entries.zh: 我们在争吵变成暴力滋事之前离开了。

entries.en: The old bacteriology index gives agglutinum a separate heading.
entries.zh: 旧细菌学索引为细菌凝质单列了标题。

entries.meaningZh: 产生凝集素的（所给旧形式）
entries.en: The historical chart labels the response agglutogenia.
entries.zh: 这幅历史图表把该反应标为产生凝集素的反应。

entries.en: The delays could aggravate the shortage.
entries.zh: 这些延误可能加重短缺。

entries.en: The engineer checked the aggregate used in the concrete.
entries.zh: 工程师检查了混凝土使用的集料。

entries.en: The study distinguishes aggregatory behaviour from simple contact.
entries.zh: 研究区分了聚集行为与单纯接触。

entries.en: The review explains how the term aggressins was used historically.
entries.zh: 综述解释了攻击素这一术语在历史上的用法。

entries.en: “Nobody asked me,” he said aggrievedly.
entries.zh: “没人问过我，”他愤愤不平地说。

entries.meaningZh: agidi；西非一种玉米淀粉凝糕
entries.en: The vendor served agidi with a savoury sauce.
entries.zh: 摊主给agidi玉米凝糕配上了咸味酱汁。

entries.en: The textile catalogue includes a sample labelled Agilon.
entries.zh: 纺织品目录包含一份标为阿吉纶的样品。

entries.en: The historical recipe lists Ajinomoto among the seasonings.
entries.zh: 这份历史食谱把味之素列在调味品中。

entries.meaningZh: 鼓动宣传；煽动宣传艺术
entries.en: The play combines agit-prop with broad comedy.
entries.zh: 这出戏把鼓动宣传与通俗喜剧结合起来。

entries.en: The coastal map marks the agium near the shore.
entries.zh: 海岸图在岸边附近标出了海滨群落。

entries.meaningZh: 光甲目（化石节肢动物类群）
entries.en: The fossil display includes a reconstruction labelled Aglaspida.
entries.zh: 化石展中有一个标为光甲目的复原模型。

entries.meaningZh: 斜斜地；弯曲地（方言或旧用法）
entries.en: The old verse describes the branch as hanging agly.
entries.zh: 这首旧诗描述树枝斜斜地垂着。

entries.en: The geological sketch shows agmatite around the dark fragments.
entries.zh: 地质草图显示深色碎块周围为角砾混合岩。

entries.en: The lecture introduced AGN before discussing the galaxy images.
entries.zh: 讲座先介绍活动星系核，再讨论星系影像。

entries.meaningZh: 无下颌头畸胎（历史分类名称）
entries.en: The atlas preserves agnathocephalus as the original specimen heading.
entries.zh: 图谱保留了无下颌头畸胎这一原标本标题。

entries.en: The mineral card identifies the specimen as agnesite.
entries.zh: 矿物卡把标本标为碳铋矿。

entries.en: The old text uses agnise where a modern reader would expect acknowledge.
entries.zh: 旧文本用古语agnise表达现代读者熟悉的承认。

entries.en: The glossary expands AgNOR beneath the figure.
entries.zh: 术语表在图下写出了银染核仁组织区的全称。

entries.en: The fossil catalogue groups these specimens under Agnostida.
entries.zh: 化石目录把这些标本归入球接子目。

entries.meaningZh: 阿格寇兰（所给历史制剂名）
entries.en: The old catalogue lists agocholan under its commercial names.
entries.zh: 旧目录把阿格寇兰列在商品名称中。

entries.en: The equipment list includes an agometer with a handwritten serial number.
entries.zh: 设备清单包括一台附手写序列号的计量器。

entries.meaningZh: Agong；马来西亚最高元首称号的组成部分
entries.en: The article explains the title Yang di-Pertuan Agong.
entries.zh: 文章解释了马来西亚最高元首这一称号。

entries.en: The essay examines the agonistical spirit of the festival.
entries.zh: 文章探讨了这个节庆的竞技精神。

entries.meaningZh: 抓氢的；描述金属与碳氢键相互作用的化学术语
entries.en: The structural discussion identifies an agostic interaction.
entries.zh: 结构讨论指出了一处抓氢相互作用。

entries.en: The old motherboard has a single AGP slot.
entries.zh: 这块旧主板有一个加速图形接口插槽。

entries.en: The label identifies agar-agar as the gelling ingredient.
entries.zh: 标签把琼脂标为凝胶原料。

entries.en: The train reached Agra before noon.
entries.zh: 火车在中午前抵达阿格拉。

entries.meaningZh: 同意；契约（中世纪拉丁法律术语）
entries.en: The historian translates agreamentum as agreement in this deed.
entries.zh: 历史学者在这份契据中把agreamentum译为协议。

entries.meaningZh: 同意；认可，尤指外交使节人选的同意
entries.en: The diplomat waited for the host country’s agrement.
entries.zh: 外交官等待东道国对其人选表示同意。

entries.en: The museum placed an Alamosaurus model near the entrance.
entries.zh: 博物馆在入口附近放置了一个阿拉摩龙模型。

entries.meaningZh: 铝氢化物中的铝酸盐类（alanate）
entries.en: The materials review distinguishes an alanate from an ordinary oxide.
entries.zh: 材料综述区分了铝氢化物盐与普通氧化物。

entries.en: There were three Alans on the guest list.
entries.zh: 宾客名单上有三个人都叫艾伦。

entries.meaningZh: 类分析；拟分析（所给术语）
entries.en: The author separates alanysis from the formal analysis that follows.
entries.zh: 作者把类分析与后面的正式分析分开。

entries.meaningZh: ALARA；合理可行的尽量低原则
entries.en: The policy summary explains the ALARA principle without giving operating instructions.
entries.zh: 政策摘要解释了合理可行的尽量低原则，没有给出操作指示。

entries.meaningZh: 翼状的；拉丁语解剖形容词
entries.en: The anatomical glossary translates alaris as wing-like.
entries.zh: 解剖术语表把alaris译为翼状的。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉斯加烘焙甜点的复数简称
entries.en: The menu offered individual baked Alaskas.
entries.zh: 菜单提供单人份烘焙阿拉斯加甜点。

entries.en: The chemical register includes alatamine in the index.
entries.zh: 化学登记册在索引中收录了鬼箭羽碱。

entries.en: The botanist explained alatus as meaning winged.
entries.zh: 植物学家解释说，alatus意为有翅的。

entries.en: The translator rendered Alaun as alum.
entries.zh: 译者把德语Alaun译为明矾。

entries.en: The exhibit shows an altazimuth with its original stand.
entries.zh: 展品展示了一台带原支架的地平经纬仪。

entries.en: The geological index records albafite as an older material name.
entries.zh: 地质索引把albafite记录为地沥青的旧名称。

entries.en: The sample card labels the pale rock albanite.
entries.zh: 样品卡把这种浅色岩石标为白榴岩。

entries.en: The glossary explains albation as a whitening process.
entries.zh: 术语表把albation解释为漂白过程。

entries.en: The diagram marks the reflected signal as an albedo wave.
entries.zh: 图中把反射信号标为反照波。

entries.meaningZh: 高级皂石（所给矿物名称）
entries.en: The old mineral catalogue lists alberence.
entries.zh: 旧矿物目录收录了高级皂石。

entries.en: The tailor showed us a sample of alberts.
entries.zh: 裁缝给我们看了一块艾伯特斯斜纹织物样品。

entries.en: The historical glossary includes albiduria among urine-description terms.
entries.zh: 历史术语表把白尿列在尿液描述术语中。

entries.en: The bibliography lists an early article on albikoviromycin.
entries.zh: 参考书目列出了一篇关于阿必病毒霉素的早期文章。

entries.meaningZh: 女性白化病患者（历史称谓）
entries.en: The historian notes that albiness was once used for a woman with albinism.
entries.zh: 历史学者指出，albiness曾用于称呼女性白化病患者。

entries.en: The map marks an albitophyre body beside the older rock.
entries.zh: 地图在较老岩石旁标出了一处钠长斑岩体。

entries.en: The old catalogue preserves the hyphen in Albo-carbon.
entries.zh: 旧目录保留了Albo-carbon这一历史材料名称中的连字符。

entries.en: The chemical index includes alboleersin under its historical spelling.
entries.zh: 化学索引按历史拼写收录了白长蠕孢菌素。

entries.en: The taxonomic note explains albomaculatus as white-spotted.
entries.zh: 分类学注释把albomaculatus解释为有白斑的。

entries.en: The engineering catalogue lists albondur as a sheet material.
entries.zh: 工程目录把纯铝包覆硬铝板列为板材。

entries.meaningZh: 白色；卵白（拉丁语旧用词）
entries.en: The translator chose egg white for albor in this passage.
entries.zh: 译者在这段文字中把albor译为卵白。

entries.en: The Albrechts moved into the house next door.
entries.zh: 阿尔布雷希特一家搬进了隔壁的房子。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔布卡西斯；历史医学家
entries.en: The reading list includes a chapter on Albucasis.
entries.zh: 阅读清单包括一章关于阿尔布卡西斯的内容。

entries.meaningZh: 清蛋白化物；白蛋白化物
entries.en: The old chemical glossary gives albumate as an alternative name.
entries.zh: 旧化学术语表把albumate列为清蛋白化物的另一名称。

entries.en: The description calls the material albuminoidal.
entries.zh: 描述称这种材料呈白蛋白样。

entries.en: The index cross-references albumone with the protein-digestion section.
entries.zh: 索引把白蛋白胨与蛋白质消化一节相互参照。

entries.meaningZh: 朊；蛋白质水解中间产物的旧称
entries.en: The historical review explains how albumose was classified.
entries.zh: 历史综述解释了朊过去如何分类。

entries.en: We stopped in Albury on the way south.
entries.zh: 我们南行途中在奥尔伯里停留。

entries.en: The manual includes a short example of ALC.
entries.zh: 手册包含一个简短的汇编语言编码示例。

entries.en: The chemical table groups the alcamines together.
entries.zh: 化学表把醇胺类归在一起。

entries.en: The itinerary follows the Alcantara valley.
entries.zh: 行程沿阿尔坎塔拉河谷展开。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔卡特朗讯（历史公司名称）
entries.en: The archive contains an Alcatel-Lucent annual report.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份阿尔卡特朗讯年度报告。

entries.en: The zoological key distinguishes alcelaphine features.
entries.zh: 动物分类检索表区分了狷羚类特征。

entries.en: The figure legend specifies alcian blue.
entries.zh: 图例注明了阿利新蓝。

entries.en: The glossary distinguishes an alcoholate from the parent alcohol.
entries.zh: 术语表区分了醇盐与其母体醇。

entries.en: The historian records alcoholase as an older enzyme name.
entries.zh: 历史学者把醇酶记为一个旧酶名。

entries.meaningZh: 酒精制品；酒精处理物（旧用法）
entries.en: The catalogue groups the alcoholizate with other prepared extracts.
entries.zh: 目录把这种酒精制品与其他加工提取物归为一类。

entries.en: The historical glossary uses alcoholophilia for a craving for alcohol.
entries.zh: 历史术语表用alcoholophilia称呼嗜酒癖。

entries.meaningZh: 粗制小麦粉（所给食品名称）
entries.en: The mill’s old price list includes alcomeal.
entries.zh: 磨坊的旧价目表包括粗制小麦粉。

entries.en: The materials inventory lists Alcotex by its trade name.
entries.zh: 材料清单按商品名称列出了Alcotex。

entries.meaningZh: 烃氧基金属化合物；醇盐
entries.en: The chemical glossary gives alcoxide as a spelling variant of alkoxide.
entries.zh: 化学术语表把alcoxide列为alkoxide，即醇盐的拼写变体。

entries.en: The newspaper devoted a full page to the ALCS.
entries.zh: 报纸用整版报道美国联盟冠军系列赛。

entries.en: The specimen chart places these corals in Alcyonacea.
entries.zh: 标本图表把这些珊瑚归入软珊瑚目。

entries.meaningZh: 平静幸福的；与翠鸟传说相关的旧形式
entries.en: The memoir recalls an alcyonian summer before the upheaval.
entries.zh: 回忆录追忆了动荡发生前那个平静幸福的夏天。

entries.en: The parts diagram identifies the ALDA unit.
entries.zh: 零件图标出了进气歧管压力补偿器。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔达胂（历史制剂名称）
entries.en: The pharmacy index preserves the name aldarsone.
entries.zh: 药房索引保留了阿尔达胂这一名称。

entries.en: The diagram places ALDC within the control system.
entries.zh: 图中把自动载荷与传动控制置于控制系统内。

entries.en: The botanical description calls the shrub alder-leaved.
entries.zh: 植物描述称这种灌木的叶片似桤木。

entries.en: The review defines ALDH before discussing the enzyme family.
entries.zh: 综述在讨论该酶家族前定义了醛脱氢酶。

entries.meaningZh: Aldoform；阿尔多仿（历史制剂名称）
entries.en: The museum catalogue includes an Aldoform carton.
entries.zh: 博物馆目录包含一个阿尔多仿纸盒。

entries.en: The archive photograph shows an Aldomet package.
entries.zh: 档案照片展示了一个爱道美包装。

entries.en: The glossary contrasts an aldoside with the corresponding free sugar.
entries.zh: 术语表把醛糖苷与对应的游离糖进行对比。

entries.en: The historical index lists aldosteronuria among endocrine terms.
entries.zh: 历史索引把醛固酮尿列在内分泌术语中。

entries.en: The aircraft materials catalogue lists aldural sheet.
entries.zh: 航空材料目录列出了包纯铝的硬铝合金板。

entries.en: The historian translates aleator as gambler in the legal text.
entries.zh: 历史学者在法律文本中把aleator译为赌博者。

entries.meaningZh: costmary芳香草本（Tanacetum balsamita；另明植物身份）
entries.en: She rubbed an alecost leaf between her fingers and noticed its strong scent.
entries.zh: 她用手指揉了揉一片costmary叶子，闻到了浓烈的香气。

entries.meaningZh: 阿利多（此例指美国得克萨斯州Aledo市；另明地点）
entries.en: We reached Aledo after sunset and looked for somewhere to eat.
entries.zh: 日落后，我们到了阿利多，想找个地方吃饭。

entries.en: The writer sought to alembicate years of experience into a short book.
entries.zh: 作者试图把多年的经验提炼成一本短书。

entries.en: The collection includes an alcoholometer in a wooden case.
entries.zh: 藏品中有一台装在木盒里的酒精比重计。

entries.en: The lecturer used aleph-null to denote the size of a countably infinite set.
entries.zh: 讲师用阿列夫零表示可数无限集的大小。

entries.meaningZh: alerce树（Fitzroya cupressoides；另选明确树种义）
entries.en: An alerce stood beside the narrow trail, its crown lost in the mist.
entries.zh: 一棵alerce树立在狭窄的小径旁，树冠隐没在雾中。

entries.en: The histological drawing labels an aletocyte near the tissue boundary.
entries.zh: 组织学图在组织边界附近标出了一个游走细胞。

entries.en: The glossary cross-references aleucocytosis with leukopenia.
entries.zh: 术语表把aleucocytosis与白细胞减少症相互参照。

entries.en: The diagram labels the aleurone layer of the grain.
entries.zh: 图中标出了谷粒的糊粉层。

entries.meaningZh: 与痛觉有关的（医学；另明所选范围）
entries.en: Her lecture distinguished algetic sensation from the simple detection of pressure.
entries.zh: 她在讲座中区分了痛觉与对压力的单纯感知。

entries.meaningZh: 寒冷（正式或文学语体；据algid另补状态名词义）
entries.en: The algidness of the unheated room drove them back to the kitchen.
entries.zh: 没供暖的房间很冷，冷得他们又回到了厨房。

entries.meaningZh: 以藻类为食的（显式补充准确形容词义）
entries.en: The algivorous fish spent much of the morning grazing on the film covering the rocks.
entries.zh: 那条以藻类为食的鱼早上大部分时间都在啃食岩石表面的薄层。

entries.meaningZh: 恐痛的（据algophobia明确补充形容词义）
entries.en: The fictional character's algophobic reaction makes him refuse even a harmless stage illusion.
entries.zh: 这个虚构人物因害怕疼痛而作出的反应，使他连无害的舞台幻术也拒绝参加。

entries.meaningZh: 司法执法人员（alguacil的异体拼法；此例为历史语境）
entries.en: The alguazil in the play carries a summons, not a soldier's orders.
entries.zh: 剧中的司法执法人员带来的是传票，而不是军令。

entries.meaningZh: 已赴麦加朝觐的穆斯林男子的尊称（西非英语）
entries.en: Alhaji Musa welcomed the visitors and showed them to the shaded courtyard.
entries.zh: 穆萨阿尔哈吉欢迎来客，并把他们领到阴凉的院子里。

entries.meaningZh: 散沫花（henna的旧称；本例谈其叶片）
entries.en: The old botanical account describes alhenna leaves being dried before they were ground.
entries.zh: 那篇旧植物学记述描写了散沫花叶在研磨前被晾干的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 从营养供给方面（据alimental父条明补副词义）
entries.en: The historian examined how the expedition was supported alimentally during the winter.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了那次考察活动在冬季如何获得食物营养方面的支持。

entries.meaningZh: 使物件对齐的装置（aligner的罕见拼法；另补名词义）
entries.en: The technician adjusted the aliner until the two edges met evenly.
entries.zh: 技术员调节对齐装置，直到两条边缘平齐地接合。

entries.meaningZh: Alka-Seltzer品牌泡腾药品（另明品牌，不提供用药建议）
entries.en: She checked the Alka-Seltzer carton to make sure she had picked up the product she wanted.
entries.zh: 她查看了Alka-Seltzer包装盒，确认自己拿的是想找的那种产品。

entries.meaningZh: 喜碱性环境的（显式补充准确复合形容词义）
entries.en: We kept the alkaline-loving plants in a separate bed from the acid-loving shrubs.
entries.zh: 我们把喜碱性环境的植物与喜酸性的灌木分种在不同的花坛里。

entries.meaningZh: 碱化剂（据alkalise父条明补施事物名词义）
entries.en: The technician compared two alkalisers before choosing one for the laboratory trial.
entries.zh: 技术员比较了两种碱化剂，然后选了一种用于实验室试验。

entries.meaningZh: 长链烯酮类（此例为海洋藻类产生的脂质）
entries.en: The team analysed alkenones in the sediment while reconstructing past sea temperatures.
entries.zh: 团队在重建过去海水温度时，分析了沉积物中的长链烯酮类物质。

entries.meaningZh: 烷撑基（二价饱和脂肪族基团；另明所选义）
entries.en: The structural diagram uses an alkylene group to connect the two labelled units.
entries.zh: 结构图用一个烷撑基连接两个标出的单元。

entries.en: The small theatre needed an all-arounder who could sew costumes and repair scenery.
entries.zh: 那家小剧院需要一位既能缝戏服又能修布景的多面手。

entries.meaningZh: 包罗一切的性质（据all-inclusive另补名词义）
entries.en: The editor questioned the claimed all-inclusiveness of a guide that left out rural transport.
entries.zh: 编辑对一本遗漏乡村交通的指南所声称的全面性提出了质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 尿囊的（此例为胚胎解剖义）
entries.en: The lecturer pointed to the allantoid membrane in the embryo diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师指着胚胎示意图中的尿囊膜。

entries.meaningZh: 使人平静者（另选安抚者名词义，并非抑制器）
entries.en: As tensions rose, she became the group's allayer, listening calmly to each complaint.
entries.zh: 气氛越来越紧张时，她成了小组里的安抚者，平静地倾听每个人的抱怨。

entries.meaningZh: 指称；未经证实的主张（另选此名词义）
entries.en: The report repeated the allegement but supplied no evidence for it.
entries.zh: 报告重复了那项指称，却没有提供支持它的证据。

entries.meaningZh: 用寓言诠释的人（英式拼法；明补人义）
entries.en: The allegoriser in the discussion treated each locked door as a symbol of fear.
entries.zh: 讨论中那位作寓意诠释的人把每一扇锁着的门都看作恐惧的象征。

entries.meaningZh: 等位基因（另补准确遗传学名词义）
entries.en: In the simplified diagram, each letter represents a different allelomorph at the same locus.
entries.zh: 在这张简化示意图中，每个字母代表同一基因座上的一种不同等位基因。

entries.meaningZh: 丙二烯类及其取代衍生物（含C=C=C结构；另明窄义）
entries.en: The lecture distinguished allenes from dienes with separated double bonds.
entries.zh: 讲座区分了含累积双键的丙二烯类与双键分隔的二烯烃。

entries.meaningZh: alli品牌减重药品（此例仅品牌识别）
entries.en: The customer showed the pharmacist a photograph of the alli box to identify the product.
entries.zh: 顾客给药剂师看了一张alli包装盒的照片，以便辨认产品。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲西鲱（Alosa alosa；另选明确鱼类义）
entries.en: The aquarium's river exhibit included an allice swimming past the viewing window.
entries.zh: 水族馆的河流展区中，一条欧洲西鲱从观景窗前游过。

entries.meaningZh: 在别处产生的（此例限定浮游生物）
entries.en: The ecologist separated allogenetic plankton carried in by the current from organisms produced locally.
entries.zh: 生态学家把水流从外地带来的浮游生物与本地产生的生物分开。

entries.meaningZh: 同种异体免疫（此处指对同种其他个体组织成分产生抗体）
entries.en: The seminar compared studies of alloimmunization rather than recommending a treatment.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了同种异体免疫的研究，而没有推荐治疗方案。

entries.meaningZh: 阿洛双酮（allomethadione；此例仅化学结构）
entries.en: The structural model of allomethadione showed an allyl group attached to the ring nitrogen.
entries.zh: 阿洛双酮的结构模型显示，一个烯丙基与环上的氮相连。

entries.meaningZh: 异种利己信息素（此例为有利于释放者的防御性化学信号）
entries.en: The researchers tested whether the repellent acted as an allomone against another insect species.
entries.zh: 研究人员检验了这种驱避物是否作为异种利己信息素，对另一种昆虫发挥作用。

entries.meaningZh: 语素异形现象（显式另选语言学义）
entries.en: The contrast between the endings of dogs and horses gave the class a simple example of allomorphy.
entries.zh: dogs和horses的词尾对比，为全班提供了一个简单的语素异形现象例子。

entries.meaningZh: 按常规医学方式（据allopathy另补此副词义）
entries.en: The historical survey described which illnesses were treated allopathically and which were approached in other ways.
entries.zh: 历史综述描述了哪些疾病按常规医学方式治疗，哪些采用了其他方式。

entries.meaningZh: 与动态适应维持稳定有关的（另补准确生理学义）
entries.en: The diagram shows an allostatic response rising during a challenge and subsiding afterwards.
entries.zh: 示意图显示了一种动态适应反应在受到挑战时增强、随后减弱的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 可分配的（据allot父条明补形容词义）
entries.en: Only the unreserved seats were allottable to late applicants.
entries.zh: 只有尚未预留的座位可分配给较晚提出申请的人。

entries.meaningZh: 在同种异型方面（明补免疫学副词义）
entries.en: The two antibody preparations were allotypically distinct despite belonging to the same class.
entries.zh: 这两种抗体制剂虽属同一类别，在同种异型方面却不同。

entries.meaningZh: 诱惑者；有吸引力的人或事物（罕见用法，派生选义）
entries.en: For the weary travellers, the smell of fresh bread was a powerful allurer.
entries.zh: 对疲惫的旅人来说，新鲜面包的香味有着强大的诱惑力。

entries.en: The structural diagram of allylacetone shows both a ketone group and a terminal double bond.
entries.zh: 烯丙基丙酮的结构图同时显示了一个酮基和一个末端双键。

entries.meaningZh: 等高圈；地平纬圈（天文学）
entries.en: On the sky chart, the two stars lay on the same almacantar.
entries.zh: 在这张星图上，这两颗恒星位于同一等高圈上。

entries.meaningZh: 阿勒曼德舞曲（旧称，另补音乐义）
entries.en: The student played the almain slowly before trying it at the marked tempo.
entries.zh: 这名学生先慢慢弹奏这首阿勒曼德舞曲，再按标明的速度演奏。

entries.en: She checked the tide times in an old almanack before planning the coastal walk.
entries.zh: 规划海岸徒步之前，她在一本旧历书里查了潮汐时间。

entries.meaningZh: 食品储藏间（英国方言或旧用，ambry的异体）
entries.en: In the old farmhouse, jars of jam lined the shelves of the almery.
entries.zh: 在那座老农舍里，一罐罐果酱摆满了食品储藏间的架子。

entries.meaningZh: 自主地的；不负封建租役义务的（历史用语）
entries.en: The document describes the estate as alodial rather than held from a feudal lord.
entries.zh: 这份文书把该地产描述为自主地产，而非从封建领主处受封持有的土地。

entries.en: The analytical report lists alonimide separately from the two reference compounds.
entries.zh: 这份分析报告把阿洛米酮与那两种参比化合物分开列出。

entries.en: The diagram distinguishes an alpha-receptor from a beta-receptor on the cell surface.
entries.zh: 这张图把细胞表面的α肾上腺素能受体与β肾上腺素能受体区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 按字母顺序排列（英国拼法的过去式）
entries.en: Mira alphabetised the recipe cards before putting them back in the drawer.
entries.zh: 米拉把食谱卡片按字母顺序排好后，放回了抽屉。

entries.meaningZh: 按字母顺序整理者（明确派生义）
entries.en: The library's volunteer alphabetizer found three names filed under the wrong letter.
entries.zh: 图书馆里负责按字母顺序整理的志愿者发现，有三个名字归在了错误的字母下面。

entries.en: The student circled the propionate group in the structural drawing of alphameprodine.
entries.zh: 学生在阿法美罗定的结构图上圈出了丙酸酯基。

entries.meaningZh: 甲病毒属（病毒分类名称）
entries.en: The phylogenetic chart places the sequence within Alphavirus.
entries.zh: 这张系统发育图将该序列归入甲病毒属。

entries.en: The chemistry lecture used alprostadil to illustrate a molecule with a carboxylic acid group.
entries.zh: 这堂化学课用前列地尔来说明带有羧酸基的分子。

entries.meaningZh: 杂三叶草（Trifolium hybridum；明确订正植物身份）
entries.en: The farmer sowed alsike in a small trial plot beside the barn.
entries.zh: 农民在谷仓旁的一小块试验田里播种了杂三叶草。

entries.meaningZh: 按祭坛通常的位置或方式（历史用语）
entries.en: The account says that the communion table was set altarwise, not in the middle of the nave.
entries.zh: 这篇记述说，圣餐桌按祭坛通常的位置摆放，而不是放在中殿中央。

entries.meaningZh: 可改变性；可修改性（明确派生义）
entries.en: The designer valued the alterableness of the layout because the exhibition was still evolving.
entries.zh: 设计师看重这种布局的可修改性，因为展览还在不断调整。

entries.meaningZh: 异硫霉素（althiomycin，抗生素化合物；本例为结构研究语境）
entries.en: The seminar compared two published methods used to establish the structure of althiomycin.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了两种已发表的、用于确定异硫霉素结构的方法。

entries.meaningZh: 高原训练（本例作复合名词定语）
entries.en: She kept a separate notebook for the altitude-training camp.
entries.zh: 她为那次高原训练营单独准备了一本笔记本。

entries.en: The weather atlas showed photographs of altostrati taken in different seasons.
entries.zh: 这本气象图集展示了在不同季节拍摄的高层云照片。

entries.meaningZh: 小翼（鸟翼前缘的羽簇；alula的复数）
entries.en: In the close-up photograph, the bird's two alulae were clearly separated from the longer wing feathers.
entries.zh: 在这张特写照片中，鸟的两处小翼与较长的翼羽清晰分开。

entries.meaningZh: 铝尘肺；吸入某些铝化合物粉尘所致的肺病（医学词）
entries.en: The history-of-medicine lecture discussed early reports of aluminosis among metal workers.
entries.zh: 医学史讲座讨论了金属工人铝尘肺的早期报告。

entries.meaningZh: 铝合金（本例作材质名词定语）
entries.en: The bicycle has an aluminum-alloy frame and steel forks.
entries.zh: 这辆自行车有铝合金车架和钢制前叉。

entries.meaningZh: 氧化铝（本例作涂层材质定语）
entries.en: An aluminum-oxide coating covered the small ceramic component.
entries.zh: 那个小陶瓷部件表面覆盖着一层氧化铝涂层。

entries.meaningZh: 蜂窝状小凹窝结构（明确形态学选义）
entries.en: The microscope image revealed fine alveolation on the surface of the pollen grain.
entries.zh: 显微镜图像显示出花粉粒表面细密的蜂窝状小凹窝结构。

entries.meaningZh: 鹅膏属真菌（amanita的复数；并非全部有毒）
entries.en: The field guide placed the amanitas in a separate section with drawings of their spore-bearing structures.
entries.zh: 这本野外图鉴把鹅膏属真菌单列一节，并配有其产孢结构的图示。

entries.en: Under the microscope, the amarillite crystals appeared pale yellow with a faint green tint.
entries.zh: 在显微镜下，黄铁钠矾晶体呈淡黄色，略带绿色。

entries.meaningZh: 可收集积累的（amass的明确派生义）
entries.en: Not all the evidence needed for the case was amassable from public records.
entries.zh: 并非案件所需的所有证据都能从公开记录中收集积累起来。

entries.meaningZh: 鰤属鱼；鰤鱼（Seriola属鱼类的通称）
entries.en: An amberjack swam past the camera while the divers were filming beside the reef.
entries.zh: 潜水员在礁石旁拍摄时，一条鰤鱼从镜头前游过。

entries.meaningZh: 双手俱利的（明确选取ambidexter的字面派生义）
entries.en: The ambidextral drummer played the same pattern equally well with either hand.
entries.zh: 那位双手俱利的鼓手用任何一只手都能同样熟练地敲出这一节奏型。

entries.meaningZh: 安必恩（Ambien，酒石酸唑吡坦的药品品牌）
entries.en: The pharmacist pointed to the word zolpidem on the Ambien label.
entries.zh: 药剂师指着安必恩标签上的唑吡坦一词。

entries.meaningZh: 悠闲缓步地（明确选取人的步行方式派生义）
entries.en: He came amblingly down the lane, stopping to inspect each garden.
entries.zh: 他沿小路悠闲缓步走来，不时停下来看看每一座花园。

entries.en: The researcher checked the amblyope's anonymous study number before comparing the vision charts.
entries.zh: 研究人员先核对了那位弱视者的匿名研究编号，再比较视力表。

entries.meaningZh: 介体（与补体共同发挥溶解作用的抗体；免疫学术语）
entries.en: The immunology lecturer drew separate symbols for the amboceptor and the complement in the diagram.
entries.zh: 免疫学讲师在图中用不同符号表示介体和补体。

entries.meaningZh: 麝香梨（一种带麝香气味的食用梨）
entries.en: At the tasting, she chose an ambrette for its musky aroma.
entries.zh: 品尝会上，她因为那股麝香气味而选了一只麝香梨。

entries.meaningZh: 毫无价值的东西（古语、文学用法）
entries.en: In the historical drama, the defeated gambler dismisses the faded bond as ambsace.
entries.zh: 在这部历史剧里，输掉赌局的赌徒把那张褪色的债券斥为毫无价值的废物。

entries.meaningZh: 氨甲达林（有机化合物名；本例为虚构实验记录）
entries.en: The two laboratories reported different measurements of amedalin in the same sample.
entries.zh: 两家实验室报告的同一样品中氨甲达林的测量结果不同。

entries.meaningZh: 唐棣属（本例为植物属名，不限定为某一个种）
entries.en: The botanist assigned the small flowering tree to Amelanchier.
entries.zh: 植物学家将那棵开花的小乔木归入唐棣属。

entries.meaningZh: 安非泼拉酮（亦称 diethylpropion，化合物名）
entries.en: The study excluded participants who were already taking amfepramone.
entries.zh: 那项研究排除了已经在服用安非泼拉酮的参与者。

entries.meaningZh: 石绒的；像细丝状石棉的
entries.en: The mineral's amianthine fibres had a fine, silky appearance.
entries.zh: 那块矿物的石绒状纤维细密，呈现出丝一般的外观。

entries.en: The fibrous amianthus was kept separate from the quartz specimens in the collection.
entries.zh: 藏品中，纤维状的石绒与石英标本分开放置。

entries.meaningZh: 美沙酮的旧称（amidone；本例讨论旧文献中的名称）
entries.en: The historian found amidone listed as an older name for methadone.
entries.zh: 历史学家发现，amidone 被列为美沙酮的一个旧称。

entries.meaningZh: 阿米卡星；一种氨基糖苷类抗生素
entries.en: The microbiologist compared two isolates with different levels of resistance to amikacin.
entries.zh: 微生物学家比较了两株对阿米卡星耐药程度不同的分离菌株。

entries.meaningZh: 胺化；向化合物中引入氨基（不等于笼统的用氨处理）
entries.en: The chemist planned to aminate the compound before comparing it with the original material.
entries.zh: 化学家计划先对该化合物进行胺化，再与原来的物质作比较。

entries.en: The analyst had to separate aminoxytriphene from several other compounds before measuring it.
entries.zh: 分析人员必须先把胺氧曲芬与另外几种化合物分离，才能对其进行测定。

entries.meaningZh: 通过无丝分裂地；通过直接分裂地（细胞生物学）
entries.en: The diagram shows the nucleus dividing amitotically, without a spindle.
entries.zh: 示意图显示细胞核在没有纺锤体的情况下，通过无丝分裂进行分裂。

entries.meaningZh: 氨氮（以氮计的氨含量；不等同于氨基）
entries.en: The team measured ammonia-nitrogen in water collected above and below the discharge point.
entries.zh: 研究小组测量了排放点上游和下游所采水样中的氨氮含量。

entries.meaningZh: 羊膜的；与羊膜有关的（amniotic 的较少见形式）
entries.en: The embryo diagram labels the amnic membrane separately from the surrounding tissues.
entries.zh: 胚胎示意图将羊膜与周围组织分开标注。

entries.en: The villain acts amorally, treating other people's suffering as irrelevant to his plans.
entries.zh: 那个反派不顾道德是非，认为别人的痛苦与自己的计划毫不相干。

entries.meaningZh: 恋爱的；带有浪漫爱情色彩的（少用）
entries.en: The letters grow increasingly amoristic, though the writer keeps denying any romantic interest.
entries.zh: 那些信越来越带有恋爱的意味，尽管写信人一直否认有任何爱慕之意。

entries.meaningZh: 可分期摊还的（本例指债务）
entries.en: They compared an amortisable loan with a debt repayable in one lump sum.
entries.zh: 他们比较了一笔可分期摊还的贷款和一笔须一次还清的债务。

entries.meaningZh: 以水陆两用的方式（本例形容交通工具行进）
entries.en: The prototype can travel amphibiously, crossing the pond before rolling up the bank.
entries.zh: 这辆原型车能水陆两用，先驶过池塘，再沿岸坡开上来。

entries.en: The wording was amphibological: either the man or the woman could be the person holding the key.
entries.zh: 那段措辞存在歧义：拿着钥匙的人，既可能是那个男人，也可能是那个女人。

entries.meaningZh: 两亲性的；同时具有亲水和疏水部分的（不是酸碱两性）
entries.en: In the model, the amphipathic molecules had water-attracting heads and water-repelling tails.
entries.zh: 在那个模型中，两亲性分子具有亲水的头部和疏水的尾部。

entries.meaningZh: 双耳细颈罐的；似双耳细颈罐的（本例为古代陶器义）
entries.en: The potter gave the new vase an amphoral shape, with a narrow neck and two handles.
entries.zh: 陶工把新花瓶做成双耳细颈罐的形状，有细长的颈部和两个把手。

entries.meaningZh: 可被逗乐的；容易找到乐趣的（少用）
entries.en: The children were still amusable after the long delay, laughing at the shadow puppets on the wall.
entries.zh: 长时间的延误之后，孩子们仍能被逗乐，看着墙上的手影笑了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 杏仁体；火成岩孔隙中形成的圆状矿物充填体（amygdule 的较少见拼法，不指未充填的空孔）
entries.en: The geologist traced the outline of a pale amygdale in the dark volcanic rock.
entries.zh: 那位地质学家描出了深色火山岩中一颗浅色杏仁状矿物充填体的轮廓。

entries.meaningZh: 字母易位的；把字母重排成新词的（较少见形式）
entries.en: The puzzle imposes an anagrammatical constraint: each answer must rearrange all the letters in the clue.
entries.zh: 这道谜题有一个字母易位的限制：每个答案都必须重新排列提示中的全部字母。

entries.meaningZh: 以回指前文的方式（本例为语法义，不是首语反复的修辞义）
entries.en: In the second sentence, 'she' refers anaphorically to the woman already introduced.
entries.zh: 在第二句中，she 以回指的方式指向前面已经介绍过的那位女性。
